result.title: Flat-RLVR: Sharpness-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Reasoning Capacity in LLMs
result.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a central paradigm for the post-training of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is highly effective at enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it commonly induces \textit{distribution sharpening}, whereby the policy distribution becomes excessively peaked and rare-yet-correct trajectories are progressively suppressed, thus diminishing sample diversity. To this end, we promote flat-reward optima in RLVR to smooth the policy distribution. We theoretically link flat reward RLVR to reduced distribution sharpening, and empirically show improved sample diversity while maintaining single-attempt accuracy. Our method, called \texttt{Flat}-RLVR, searches for flat reward regions via sharpness-aware minimization during LLM post-training, combining this with GRPO variants to achieve better trade-offs between sampling efficiency and reasoning capacity.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 RLVR/GRPO 导致的分布锐化与稀有正确轨迹被抑制问题，提出 Flat-RLVR：用 sharpness-aware minimization 在训练中寻找平坦奖励区域，以平滑策略分布，在保持单次准确率的同时提升采样多样性。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于纯文本 RLVR 训练方法，未涉及视觉或 latent 推理状态；其平坦奖励解与保持多样性的思路，可能为 latent 轨迹训练中的探索、监督与贡献分配提供借鉴线索，可供核查。
